Messages.Author: Ivengar
Messages.Body:
I know equipping is considered a non repeat action but what if it is
deferent pieces of equipment? I know you can rush multiple times as
long as you use deferent rush cards. Is this the same for equipping?
EG, equip a leather jaket and untap with freak drive then equip a gun?

Also I am sure of this but might as well throw it out there, if given
enough untaps I should be able to equip something, recruit an ally and
hire a retainer correct?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Ivengar wrote:
> I know equipping is considered a non repeat action but what if it is
> deferent pieces of equipment? I know you can rush multiple times as
> long as you use deferent rush cards. Is this the same for equipping?
> EG, equip a leather jaket and untap with freak drive then equip a gun?

Yes.

> Also I am sure of this but might as well throw it out there, if given
> enough untaps I should be able to equip something, recruit an ally and
> hire a retainer correct?

Yes.

You can employ as many different retainers as you like and recruit as
many different allies as you like and equip as many different equipment
as you like.
